en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal flower garden in a city park. Flowerbeds with blooming plants line a wide path. A woman in early 20th‑century dress stands on the path holding a hat, while wooden benches sit beneath wooden trellises covered with climbing plants. Trees and a hazy cityscape appear in the distant background. The caption at the bottom reads "CHEMNITZ. STADTPARK. BLUMENGARTEN."
